title: Studio route ownership and local connector
summary: Route-counted ownership for the Angular Studio, a constrained local connector, and the remote Task Server, including the D4b migration estimate and Robert's decision gate.

implementationTasks.title: Create the OrchestratorApi connector profile
implementationTasks.acceptanceScope: Loopback listener, strict route allowlist, Studio credential injection, Origin and CSRF enforcement, health, and atomic upstream selection. No local task authority is hosted.
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Add an OrchestratorApi `connector` profile that binds only to `[::1]:5031`. Map only the 95 `dev-seat` operations in `docs/studio-route-ownership/routes.json`, proxy the Task Server operations, and fail startup if any unclassified `/api` or `/hubs` endpoint is exposed. Inject the Studio bearer from Windows Credential Manager in native mode or a read-only secret file in Docker mode. Enforce the Origin, Host, session, CSRF, header-stripping, health, protocol, and atomic upstream-switch contracts in the dossier. Add route-surface and security tests. Do not host task storage, schedulers, or Runner authority.

implementationTasks.title: Move the core attach routes to Task Server v1
implementationTasks.acceptanceScope: The 27 P0 operations in the core-attach bundle work through the remote connector, including resumable live updates.
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Implement the `core-attach` route IDs from `docs/studio-route-ownership/routes.json` in the standalone Task Server v1 API. Preserve stable workspace, project, task, and run identities; remove `watchPath` as authority; and provide the `/hubs/jobs` compatibility path through a replayable Task Server event stream. Prove login/session bootstrap, board load, task create/move/start/stop/continue, orchestrator chat, reconnect from a cursor, and Studio-detached execution through the connector.

implementationTasks.title: Move task detail and host control routes
implementationTasks.acceptanceScope: The 111 P1 operations use Task Server resources and Runner evidence without direct Studio access to a Runner or task workspace.
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Implement the `task-detail-and-hosts` route IDs from `docs/studio-route-ownership/routes.json`. Add versioned task history, attempts, artifacts, pipeline, host, workspace, and policy contracts. Split `GET /api/tasks/{taskId}/files/{path*}` so Task Server task files remain remote while `scope=code` becomes a separately named dev-seat route. Keep authorization, optimistic concurrency, idempotency, and artifact content tests at the versioned boundary.

implementationTasks.title: Move operations and insight routes
implementationTasks.acceptanceScope: The 102 P2 operations read durable Task Server projections and dispatch execution through fenced Runner contracts.
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Implement the `operations-and-insight` route IDs from `docs/studio-route-ownership/routes.json`. Move bus, runtime, cycle-time, token, deployment, security-review, analysis, drift, supervisor, and recovery projections into Task Server v1. Where computation needs a checkout or CLI, dispatch a fenced Runner operation and persist the resulting events and artifacts in the Task Server. Do not let the connector become a workflow engine.

implementationTasks.title: Move administration and long-tail routes
implementationTasks.acceptanceScope: The 24 P3 operations have explicit v1 contracts or are removed from Angular before cutover.
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Resolve every `administration-and-tail` route ID in `docs/studio-route-ownership/routes.json`. Implement the route in Task Server v1 when it represents current product behavior; otherwise remove the Angular call and reclassify it as retired with evidence. Split mixed global search so task results are Task Server-owned and repository commit/file search has an explicit dev-seat boundary. Update the inventory and keep every frontend operation classified exactly once.

statusReason: Entscheidung 07.09. durch den Orchestrator unter Roberts Autonomie-Freigabe: Connector-Profil des OrchestratorApi, 95-Routen-Dev-Seat-Allowlist, nativer Windows-Connector bei Docker-Task-Server, Reihenfolge P0-P3, 88 Tage Baseline (71-115). Promotion zu fuenf Implementierungskarten.
